description: Figure 2 is a pie chart that visually represents the taxonomy on medical ethics. The inner circle of the pie chart is divided into four segments, each representing one of the four pillar principles in medicine. The outer circle of the pie chart is divided into 26 segments, each representing a category clustered from 256 detailed principles. The chart is color-coded, with each segment having a distinct color to differentiate between the categories. The chart does not include a legend, percentage labels inside the slices, or any slices that are visually emphasized. The segments are ordered in a way that the four pillar principles are grouped together in the inner circle, and the 26 categories are spread out in the outer circle.
